items.title: SS Retail IPO bags mixed views from analysts as valuations bite; GMP at 30%
items.description: SS Retail IPO: Brokerages took note of the company's strong positioning in Tier II & Tier III markets along with its sectoral leadership; however, they flagged the steep valuations.

items.title: Glass Wall Systems shares debut at 7% premium on NSE, miss expectations
items.description: Glass Wall Systems IPO GMP was 21 per cent ahead of the debut, while the stock debuted at just 7 per cent upside over the offer price.

items.title: NSE IPO opens on Sept 17; check price band, lot size, GMP & how to apply
items.description: NSE IPO subscription will start on September 17 and conclude on September 21. NSE has set the price band at  ₹1,700 to ₹1,785. Investors can bid for 8 shares in each lot.

items.title: The valuation puzzle: What makes BSE pricier than IPO-ready NSE?
items.description: NSE IPO: BSE's improving operating leverage and residual room to expand in cash equities, where NSE still holds ~93 per cent, has justified a scarcity-and-momentum premium for the listed exchange.
